## Summary

Describe the problem and the change. Identify the affected page section or documentation.

## Change type

- [ ] Visual or responsive improvement
- [ ] Semantic HTML or accessibility improvement
- [ ] Asset update
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] CI or maintenance
- [ ] Other

## Implementation details

List the important files changed and explain any non-obvious decisions.

## Validation

- [ ] Ran `python scripts/validate_site.py`.
- [ ] Opened the page through a local HTTP server.
- [ ] Checked relevant desktop and mobile viewport sizes.
- [ ] Verified local images and videos load.
- [ ] Checked keyboard navigation and visible focus.
- [ ] Reviewed reduced-motion and autoplay behavior where relevant.
- [ ] Updated documentation where needed.
- [ ] Confirmed no secrets, personal data, or unauthorized assets were added.
- [ ] Did not add deceptive credential, payment, or account flows.

## Screenshots

Attach before/after screenshots for visual changes. Remove private information.

## Remaining limitations

List known issues or follow-up work. Do not describe unimplemented placeholders as functional.
